task.description:
This WF-02 continuation run resumed a stalled prior run (WF02-iss501-504-epic5-20260612) and finished ISS-502 (SPT cutover transaction — GitHub issue #202). TEST-RUNNER (step 04) returned PASS with all 4 test cases verified. Complete the final documentation and release steps:

1. Update CHANGELOG.md per fn:update-changelog describing: ISS-502 SPT cutover transaction completed and tested (executeSptCutover in src/admin/tenant_migration.zig); plus the two unrelated pre-existing defects fixed under Unblock-Everything during this run: (a) fresh-database bootstrap was blocked by GBL-084's pre-flight check never seeing the seeded default tenant cut over to SCHEMA mode (fixed via new migration 087_default_tenant_storage_mode_cutover.sql plus wiring provisionTenantSchema() into the migrate tool), (b) SPT_BUSINESS_TABLES incorrectly included webhook_deliveries which is not part of the TNT-01 21-table design.

2. Run `python tools/reqctl.py set-status ISS-502 TESTED --implemented-in src/admin/tenant_migration.zig` then `python tools/reqctl.py set-status ISS-502 RELEASED --implemented-in src/admin/tenant_migration.zig` (check reqctl.py's actual accepted status values first via `python tools/reqctl.py --help` or show an already-RELEASED requirement like ISS-501/503/504's sibling status progression if TESTED is not a valid intermediate status name in this tool — use whatever the real accepted status vocabulary is; do not guess). Do NOT hand-edit docs/status/requirement_status.yaml.

3. Run `python tools/reqctl.py render-status` to regenerate docs/status/requirement_status.yaml from docs/requirements.yaml.

4. Check whether this run has an estimation.json (handoffs/WF02-iss502-continuation-20260730/estimation.json — it exists) and run the retrospective procedure per docs/agents/metrics.md §6: compute actual work time per step from started_at/completed_at across this run's handoff files (step-03, step-00b x2 including rework, step-03b, step-04), compare to the (mostly unfilled, since this was a continuation of an already-estimated prior run rather than a fresh estimate) estimated_minutes, and write handoffs/WF02-iss502-continuation-20260730/estimation.json's actual figures plus docs/metrics/retrospectives/WF02-iss502-continuation-20260730.yaml. Since the original difficulty/surcharge estimate was rough (this run's scope grew significantly due to two rounds of unrelated blocker fixes), note that variance in the retrospective honestly rather than forcing a fit.

5. GitHub Branch Management (mandatory per CLAUDE.md Step Final): create a PR from feature/WF02-iss502-continuation-20260730 to main (`gh pr create --base main --title ".." --body ".."` referencing GitHub issue #202 — use 'Closes #202' in the PR body so merging auto-closes the issue), ensure it's mergeable, then `gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch`. Verify the branch is deleted from GitHub afterward.

6. Return the local repo to main: `git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main`, verify `git branch --show-current` outputs `main` and `git status` is clean.

Note: this repo's git remote 'origin' resolves to a URL showing 'My-Fab' with a GitHub redirect notice pointing to the real location https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co — this is expected (stale remote URL, GitHub auto-redirects), not an error; do not attempt to fix the remote URL, that's out of scope for this handoff.
acceptance_criteria: ISS-502 status progressed to RELEASED (or the correct terminal status per reqctl's real vocabulary) in docs/requirements.yaml via reqctl, never hand-edited
PR created, merged (squash + delete branch), and verified deleted from GitHub, referencing and closing issue #202
Local repo returned to main with clean working tree
